svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four lengths of 25 x 20 x 2 mm angle, 1,078 mm long on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside corner, mitred 45 deg at both ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The 25 mm leg lies on the glazing edge; the 20 mm leg hangs down

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the 20 mm leg 4.5 mm every 200 mm, 15 mm from the top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (about 8 mm into the wall below the tape and glazing).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Run a bead of silicone under the 25 mm leg.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The leg's inner edge stops 14 mm outside the aperture: no shade.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The glazing edge sits 7 mm inside the hanging leg: room to grow.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: 4 x 20 mm stainless screws into the plywood.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the trim holds the glazing down without bowing it.
